messages:
maya: FYI - multiple customers reporting embeddings requests hitting eu-west but actually routing to us-east and timing out. seeing 502s and long cold-start latencies. attaching quick repro and logs.

jamie_support: can you paste the minimal repro? which endpoint and model? any auth errors?

maya: minimal curl below. customer sets region=eu-west and model=embed-large. response shows region header us-east and long first-byte time (~3s) then 502. no auth failures.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["hello world"]}'
```

maya: log snippet: `route_decision=stick_to_us-east reason=capacity_spillover cold_start=true backend_latency_ms=3050 status=502`. customer says this started after a burst yesterday.

carlos_ml: hmm spillover + sticky routing could send to fallback region when eu-west pools saturated. but 502 on cold start is concerning (should degrade to smaller model). can you capture request-id?

maya: request-id: r-0a9f2b. customer says batch size was 24 (they batch user texts). they reduced batch to 4 and errors drop. latency still higher than expected.

alex_oncall: pinging @eng-runtime. this looks like routing policy followed fallback -> us-east but the model variant there might be quantized differently causing kernel mismatch leading to 502 on first token.

alex_oncall: immediate mitigation: tell customer to set explicit region header and enable failover=false in request to force regional routing while we triage. also suggest smaller batches for now.

jamie_support: notified customer with workaround. asked for full headers and payloads and whether they're using SDK or direct API. they replied SDK v1.4.2.

carlos_ml: repro locally by simulating heavy eu-west pool and forcing spillover. I see dimension mismatch warnings in logs when fallback model variant uses 1536 dims vs expected 2048. that explains embedding decode failures on first call. we need to ensure model variant compatibility on fallback.

alex_oncall: filing an infra escalation ticket to force-compatible fallbacks and add a safety check so we never route if dims don't match. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. ticket: INFRA-7891.

maya: customer requested billing credits for failed requests (they hit 5k failing tokens). support asked billing team to review, flagged as P1.

infra-bot: deploy-plan noted: immediate hotfix (disable cross-region fallback for embeddings) -> roll out to 10% -> monitor for increased error rates. if green, promote.

carlos_ml: long term: add model-family metadata so fallback picks same-dim variant or automatically transcodes embeddings if safe. also better cold-start pooling in eu-west.

jamie_support: closing loop with customer: provided workaround (region header + failover=false) and ETA for fix (hotfix in ~2h, full mitigation next week). customer accepted credits request pending billing. :thumbsup:

maya: will keep thread updated after INFRA-7891 progresses. thanks all.
